data.name: Sidhanta
data.gender_notes: Sidhanta is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Sidhanta is recorded with the meaning “Goal, Aim, Intention”. Sidhanta is a Hindu name meaning “Goal, Aim, Intention”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses. Note: this meaning has not been independently verified against a classical lexicon or primary source and is flagged for source verification.

in_sanskrit.name: सिधान्त
in_sanskrit.meaning: Conclusion, Doctrine, Dogma, Principle, Canon, Rule
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: From the root sidh, to accomplish, attain, achieve, and the suffix ant, which denotes a principle, conclusion, or rule.

in_hindi.name: सिधान्त
in_hindi.meaning: सिद्ध अर्थ, सिद्ध प्रकार, निर्णय, निर्णयकर्ता
in_hindi.long_meaning: सिध (सिध्यति) होने वाला अर्थ या प्रकार या निर्णय या निर्णयकर्ता

in_tamil.name: சிதந்த
in_tamil.long_meaning: சித (சித்தல்) அல்லவாக் கடவுசித்தல் அல்லவாக் கடமை, சுற்று, மதிப்பு

in_marathi.name: Sidhanta
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goal, Aim, Intention
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sidhanta हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The one who has reached the ultimate goal, one who has attained a great knowledge or insight

in_bengali.name: Sidhanta
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Goal, Aim, Intention
